title.zh: 查看数据膨胀相关信息

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于查看存储弹性模式的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的数据膨胀状态，实例内核小版本需为V6.3.10.1及以上，如何查看和升级内核小版本，请参见查看[内核小版本](~~277424~~)和[版本升级](~~139271~~)。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query the details of data bloat on an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in elastic storage mode. The minor version of the instance must be V6.3.10.1 or later. For more information about how to view and update the minor version of an instance, see [View the minor engine version](~~277424~~) and [Update the minor engine version](~~139271~~).

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instance-data-bloat --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --database test --order-by Field:_TableName,_Type:_Desc --region cn-hangzhou
